subject: Acme credit matrix: proposed concession after prefetch delay
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, James Lee <james.lee@acmecorp.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme credit matrix: proposed concession after prefetch delay

Team — looping you in early. Acme just told us their integration timeline slipped because they were relying on our prefetch KV performance optimization (scheduled for Q3). They are requesting a concession/credit to cover spend while the feature hits their SLA target. High-level ask from James:

- $150k credit spread over 6 months, applied as monthly billing credit
- Legal amendment + DocuSign signature

Attached: SOW-Acme-v2.pdf (current contract), acme-credit-matrix.xlsx (customer requested template)

What I need from product/finance/legal:
- Product confirmation that preftech (prefetch KV) is the only blocker and expected ETA (is Q3 still realistic?)
- A recommended credit sizing (prefer smaller, staged credit tied to milestones) and any alternatives (credits + SLA ramp, or temporary rate reduction)
- Quick note on customer-facing language (we want to avoid precedent but keep the account healthy)

Can we get a recommendation and an exec approval path? Acme is a strategic mid-market account; Sales wants to send a formal proposal to James by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme credit matrix: proposed concession after prefetch delay

Connor — thanks for flagging and for the attachments. Short answers from product: 

- The prefetch KV change is still scoped for mid-Q3 (target: 2027-07-15 internal ETA). There is some risk +/- 2 weeks depending on third-party kernel availability.
- The blocker for Acme is end-to-end latency for multi-tenant cold-starts; there is a viable workaround (aggressive prefix caching + temporary dedicated warm pools) but it adds ~$12k/mo incremental infra cost for us and complexity for their integration.

Recommendation:
- Offer a phased concession tied to concrete milestones rather than a flat $150k upfront. Example: 50% credit for first 2 months, 25% for next 2 months, then 0% once prefetch ships and we validate their SLA. If we adopt warm pools as a stop-gap, require a short-term premium to cover infra cost (pass-through or split 50/50).

Customer-facing note: "We understand the timing impact and propose a short-term, milestone-based accommodation while we deliver the prefetch optimization. This approach preserves alignment and avoids establishing an open-ended precedent."

I can provide a one-page technical annex for the customer explaining the ETA and validation plan.

—Laura
Director, Product Management (Serving Runtime)
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme credit matrix: proposed concession after prefetch delay

Sounds reasonable. From commercial/ops perspective I suggest we cap total concession exposure and tie it to the deal_id. Proposed commercial structure:

- Cap: $100k total credit (max exposure)
- Payout: applied as monthly billing credit over 4 months (easier ops) — 40%/30%/20%/10% (front-loaded)
- Conditions: must sign an amendment (DocuSign) that includes the technical annex, milestone dates, and a clause that credits are void if Acme fails to adopt the recommended warming pattern within 30 days.

Next steps: Connor — please draft the one-pager and proposed amendment language. I can expedite revenue ops approval if you include the exact credit schedule and the HubSpot deal id. If this looks right, I can loop in finance for final sign-off and legal for the amendment.

-Aditya
VP, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>

Thanks all — below is the proposal I sent to Acme (copying language and attaching the amendment draft). Posting here for record and to request exec sign-off from finance/legal: 

----- Forwarded proposal to Acme (sent 2027-04-29 16:30 PT) -----
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: James Lee <james.lee@acmecorp.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@acmecorp.com>
Subject: Redwood proposal: short-term credit + milestone plan

Hi James / Sara — appreciate the candid update. Based on our internal review, Redwood proposes the following short-term accommodation to keep your rollout on track while we deliver the prefetch KV optimization: 

1) Credit schedule (cap $100,000): applied as billing credit over 4 months: Month1 40% ($40k), Month2 30% ($30k), Month3 20% ($20k), Month4 10% ($10k).
2) Conditions: customer to implement recommended warming pattern within 30 days (we provided steps in the attached annex). If optional warm pools are required, cost-sharing split to be agreed before deployment.
3) Milestones: Redwood will target 2027-07-15 for prefetch rollout; we will provide weekly status updates starting 2027-06-01 and validation testing within 7 days of rollout.
4) Execution: please sign the attached amendment (DocuSign link) to accept the credit schedule and milestone plan.

Link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcdef123456
Attachment: acme-credit-matrix.xlsx (proposed schedule), SOW-Acme-v2.pdf

We think this is fair: limits Redwood exposure, ties credits to measurable milestones, and preserves the commercial relationship. Please let me know if you need a different cadence.

Best,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

----- end forwarded proposal -----

Request: Can finance/legal confirm quick approval route for this structure? If yes, Aditya — please start the revenue ops ticket and loop finance; Marissa — can you run the amendment past legal and mark any high-risk language? Laura — can you finalize the technical annex so I can attach it to the DocuSign envelope?

Connor
